## Prefab tags
Prefab names start with a three-letter tag, then the 4-letter faction tag, to reduce text spill in targeting, e.g. `NWS [COAL] Combat Baserunner`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[NPC` | **not a known tag** | 1 | `[NPC Station] GAALSIEN Shield Generator` |
| `NAS` | Alliance structure (Base, Outpost, Turret) | 10 | `NAS [KHAA] Base 1` |
| `NCO` | Convoy lead | 3 | `NCO [COAL] Kapisi` |
| `NCS` | Transport, Trader or Freighter | 5 | `NCS [COAL] Cargo Cruiser` |

## Behavior inits
Every behavior's init action sets its Encounter Type and display name, and aircraft also set a bool:
`[CustomStrings:EncounterType,UnitSmall]`, `[CustomStrings:EncounterDisplayName,aircraft]`, `[SetBooleansTrue:GVK_MobilityType_Aircraft]`.
Structures that spawn Defenses also set `[CustomCountersVariables:DefenseSpawn_Limit,<n>]`.
